Based on the family archive, this is the story of the Liu family, centered around parents Feng Kuang Liu (劉豐光) and Meichu Grace Liu (劉彭美珠):

**The Parents:**
Feng Kuang Liu was born January 23, 1943, in Taiwan and worked as an engineer and realtor. He became a naturalized U.S. citizen and lived in Sunnyvale, California. Meichu Grace Liu (彭美珠) was born March 11, 1947. The couple established the Liu Family Trust on February 9, 1990, as co-trustors and co-trustees.

**Their Children:**
The family had two children: Karen Peling Liu and Kenny Peng Liu. Both are represented extensively in the archive with 38 and 45 linked documents respectively.

**Family Tragedies:**
Meichu Grace Liu passed away first on June 16, 2004, at Stanford Medical Center, with her memorial service held on June 21, 2004, at Spangler Mortuaries in Los Altos, California. Feng Kuang Liu died six years later on June 6, 2010, at age 67, at Lahey Clinic Northshore in Peabody, Massachusetts, from cardiac failure.

**Estate Complexity:**
After both parents' deaths, the family estate involved complex trust arrangements including Trust A, Trust B (established March 14, 2005), and a Personal Residence Trust. This led to legal disputes requiring court intervention, with Karen serving as successor trustee for Trust A and Reiling Liao for Trust B.

results.question: What do we know about the family's financial and legal history?
results.answer:
Based on the family archive, the Liu family has an extensive financial and legal history documented through 90 documents linked to Feng Kuang Liu and 64 to Meichu Grace Liu.

## Trust and Estate Structure
The family established a revocable living trust on February 9, 1990, with Feng Kuang Liu and Meichu Grace Liu as co-trustors and co-trustees. After Meichu's death in 2004, this split into separate trusts, including the "Meichu Grace Liu B Trust" (irrevocable, established March 14, 2005) and the "Feng Kuang Liu A Trust."

## Legal Disputes and Court Actions
Following Feng Kuang Liu's death on June 6, 2010, significant legal disputes arose over trusteeship. In 2011, Karen Peling Liu and Kenny Peng Liu filed a Superior Court petition (Case No. 1-10-PR 168 002) in Santa Clara County seeking judicial confirmation that Karen was the rightful successor trustee of the "A" Trust. The archive contains multiple court filings, successor trustee acceptance documents, and probate notifications under Probate Code Section 16061.7.

## Financial Documentation
The archive includes comprehensive financial account statements and asset valuations compiled around the time of the deaths, joint federal tax returns (including 1982 Form 1040 showing Feng-Kuang as engineer/realtor), wire transfer receipts (including a 1989 Chase Manhattan Bank transfer of $135,663.00), and CalPERS Special Power of Attorney documents.

## Additional Legal Documents
Other legal materials include death certificates, immigration documents (Affidavit of Support Form I-134), medical records, and estate attorney correspondence with Robert A.
